name: Veltrio Verified Reviews for WooCommerce
author: veltrio

sections.description:
Veltrio Verified Reviews sends a configurable review request after a WooCommerce order is completed. The customer opens an order-specific link, rates the purchased products without creating an account, and the result is stored as a native WooCommerce product review.

For reviews collected through that link, the product page can show the purchase date and review date under the review. Reviews that predate the plugin do not receive that evidence. The plugin reports facts it can verify; it does not certify that a store complies with any law.

The free plugin includes:

  • A configurable delay, email subject, message, button text and button colour.
  • One request per eligible completed order, with checks for refunds, invalid addresses and duplicate sends.
  • An order-specific review page with accessible star controls and no customer login requirement.
  • Native WooCommerce reviews that continue to use WordPress moderation, blocked-word and antispam flows.
  • A visible purchase-and-review-date proof for reviews collected through the plugin.
  • Optional customer photos in JPG, PNG or WebP. Location metadata is removed before publication, and the photo remains private until its review is approved.
  • A 90-day event log, test email, privacy exporter and privacy eraser.
  • A CSV importer that does not trust an imported “verified” flag: it checks purchases in the store before adding purchase evidence.
  • An optional Google business testimonials section, kept separate from product reviews and never labelled as a verified purchase.
  • HPOS compatibility.

Installation and activation do not send requests for old orders. Requests are disabled initially and the safety window starts when the plugin is first activated.

The settings page lists optional Pro features and links to the Pro version. Their implementation is not included in this wordpress.org package.

External services

The optional Google testimonials tool uses the Google Places Details API at maps.googleapis.com. No request is made automatically. A request is made only when an administrator enters a Google API key and Place ID and presses the button to fetch reviews.

That request sends the API key, the business Place ID, the requested fields (reviews, url and name) and the language (es) to Google. Google returns the business profile URL and up to the reviews selected by its API, including reviewer name, rating, text, time and source URL. The returned testimonials are stored in the WordPress database. They are displayed in a separate Google section and are not treated as product reviews or purchase evidence.

Use of that API is subject to Google’s services:

  • Google Maps Platform terms: https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms
  • Google privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

The plugin makes no calls to Veltrio servers. The Pro link opens an ordinary web page only when a user clicks it. Email delivery uses the site’s existing WordPress wp_mail configuration; this plugin does not choose or connect directly to an email provider.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install the ZIP from “Plugins > Add Plugin”, or upload the veltrio-verified-reviews-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate “Veltrio Verified Reviews for WooCommerce”.
  4. Open “WooCommerce > Veltrio Verified Reviews”, review the email and delay, then enable review requests when ready.

If the paid edition is installed and active, this free package stays inactive. Both editions use the same settings and review data.
sections.faq:
Does activating the plugin email customers from old orders?

No. Activation records a safety boundary, requests are disabled initially, and automatic recovery does not look behind that boundary. The settings page has a separate manual flow for recent unsent orders, so an administrator can review them before choosing to queue anything.

Where are reviews stored?

They are native WordPress/WooCommerce product reviews. Uninstalling the plugin never deletes comments or reviews.

Why do some reviews not show purchase and review dates?

Only reviews whose purchase relationship the plugin can establish receive that evidence. It does not add proof to an older or unrelated review when it cannot verify its origin.

Does the plugin guarantee legal compliance?

No. It exposes verifiable facts about reviews collected through its order-specific link. Store configuration, publication decisions and legal obligations remain the store owner’s responsibility.

Does it require an SMTP plugin?

No. It sends through WordPress wp_mail. Reliable delivery depends on the site’s mail configuration; SMTP is commonly used but is not required by Veltrio Verified Reviews.

What data is sent to Google?

Only when an administrator presses the fetch button: the configured API key, Place ID, requested fields and language. See “External services” above for the returned and stored fields.
sections.changelog:
0.18.5

  • First wordpress.org package generated from the same 0.18.5 source as the paid edition.
  • Excludes all Pro, licensing, Control Center and custom updater code.
  • Adds safe coexistence with the paid package while preserving shared settings and native reviews.
  • Prevents uninstalling either edition from deleting shared plugin data while the other edition remains installed.
